title: A string compared with a UUID is cast to UUID
verdict: `uuid = 'text'` casts the text to `UUID`; a malformed text raises
description: Comparing a `UUID` with a string casts the string to `UUID`, so any spelling `CAST(s AS UUID)` accepts is equal to the same value: upper case, no hyphens, in braces. A text that is no UUID raises a ConversionException. Read as text, `id = upper(id::VARCHAR)` matches every row in DuckDB and none in a text model.
reference: sverify refuses the column by its declared type (`sverify_duckdb.declared`, #1253): Arrow exports it as another kind, and the lift would compare it as that kind. The exit is a cast to text in the source query.

evidence.observed: ConversionException: Could not convert string 'nope' to UUID

evidence.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM u WHERE id = upper(id::VARCHAR)
